findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sec_filing_section, scrape_markdown · Private data: domain_enrich · Public sink: scrape_markdown, domain_enrich.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sec_filing_section, scrape_markdown · Private data: domain_enrich · Public sink: scrape_markdown, domain_enrich

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
